title: Convergence Analysis of Sequential Federated Learning on Heterogeneous Data
abstract: arXiv:2311.03154v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: There are two categories of methods in Federated Learning (FL) for joint training across multiple clients: (i) parallel FL (PFL), where clients train models in a parallel manner; and (ii) sequential FL (SFL), where clients train models in a sequential manner. In contrast to that of PFL, the convergence theory of SFL on heterogeneous data is still lacking. In this paper, we establish the convergence guarantees of SFL for strongly/general/non-convex objectives on heterogeneous data. The convergence guarantees of SFL are better than that of PFL on heterogeneous data with both full and partial client participation. Experimental results validate the counterintuitive analysis result that SFL outperforms PFL on extremely heterogeneous data in cross-device settings.

translated_title: 异构数据上顺序联邦学习的收敛性分析
translated_abstract: 联邦学习中有两类方法用于跨多个客户端的联合训练：（i）并行联邦学习（PFL），客户端以并行方式训练模型；（ii）顺序联邦学习（SFL），客户端以顺序方式训练模型。与PFL不同，SFL在异构数据上的收敛理论目前仍然缺失。本文建立了SFL在异构数据上针对强凸/一般凸/非凸目标的收敛性保证。无论是在完全客户端参与还是部分客户端参与的情况下，SFL在异构数据上的收敛性保证都优于PFL。实验结果验证了这一反直觉的分析结论：在跨设备设置中，SFL在极度异构数据上的表现优于PFL。
tldr: 本文首次建立了顺序联邦学习在异构数据上针对强凸、一般凸和非凸目标的收敛性理论保证，并证明在完全和部分客户端参与情况下SFL均优于并行联邦学习。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the convergence guarantees of sequential federated learning on heterogeneous data for strongly/general/non-convex objectives, demonstrating that SFL outperforms parallel federated learning under both full and partial client participation.
